news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on August 11
news.summary: NeurAxis confirmed it will report Q2 2026 financial results (quarter ended June 30, 2026) before market open on Tuesday, August 11, 2026, followed by a conference call at 9:00am ET to review results and provide a business update. This locks in the previously-estimated mid-August reporting date and follows a record Q1 2026 in which revenue rose 80% year over year.

news.headline: NeurAxis Declares Q2 Stock Dividend on Series B Preferred Stock
news.summary: NeurAxis's board authorized a Q2 2026 stock dividend on its Series B Preferred Stock, to be paid entirely in common shares (roughly 80,463 new shares, based on accrued dividends divided by $2.38) rather than cash. The dividend is payable July 29, 2026 to Series B holders of record as of July 21, 2026, conserving cash but modestly diluting common shareholders.

news.headline: NeurAxis Stockholders Approve Director Slate and Equity Plan Expansion at 2026 Annual Meeting
news.summary: At its June 10, 2026 annual meeting in Carmel, Indiana, NeurAxis stockholders elected all six director nominees (including CEO Brian Carrico), ratified Rosenberg Rich Baker Berman as independent auditor, and approved expanding the company's equity incentive plan pool from 1,482,152 to 3,400,000 shares alongside a new 2025 Employee Stock Purchase Plan. The larger option pool gives management added capacity to hire and retain staff as the commercial team scales.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings report and business update call
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis will report summarized Q2 2026 financial results (quarter ended June 30, 2026) before market open on Tuesday, August 11, 2026, with a conference call at 9:00am ET; investors will watch whether the reimbursement-driven revenue ramp seen in Q1 2026 (+80% YoY) continued into Q2.

catalysts.label: Series B preferred stock dividend payment
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis will issue approximately 80,463 new common shares to Series B Preferred holders of record as of July 21, 2026, in lieu of a cash dividend.

catalysts.label: Further payer/insurer coverage expansion
catalysts.detail: Following the AMA Category I CPT code for PENFS taking effect January 1, 2026 and additional insurer policy wins covering roughly 1.25 million lives announced in April 2026, NeurAxis has a pattern of periodically announcing new medical policy coverage decisions that could continue to expand its reimbursed addressable market.

catalysts.label: VA Federal Supply Schedule commercial ramp
catalysts.detail: Having secured a Veterans Affairs Federal Supply Schedule (FSS) contract designating it a federal contractor, NeurAxis is working to convert that listing into actual IB-Stim orders and utilization across the VA health system, which serves roughly 7 million patients annually; initial VA revenue traction is a watch item for upcoming quarters.

pulse: NeurAxis has been relatively quiet operationally through mid-to-late July 2026, mostly handling routine corporate items: stockholders re-elected the board and expanded the equity incentive pool at the June 10 annual meeting, a Series B Preferred stock dividend (paid in about 80,463 new common shares) settles July 29, and the company confirmed Q2 2026 results will be released August 11 with a 9am ET call. The bigger story remains the reimbursement-driven commercial ramp -- Q1 2026 revenue hit a record $1.6M (+80% YoY) on the back of the new AMA Category I CPT code, roughly 1.25 million newly covered lives from insurer wins, and a VA Federal Supply Schedule contract opening a federal sales channel. The August 11 print is the key near-term catalyst to confirm that growth and margin trajectory continued into Q2, alongside any fresh payer-coverage or VA-channel updates.
